reproduction.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.decision_id ORDER BY o.sequence DESC) rn FROM scheduling_decision_outcome o WHERE observed_at <= ?) SELECT r.outcome_id,r.turn_id,r.observed_input_tokens,r.observed_cached_input_tokens,r.observed_output_tokens,r.observed_reasoning_output_tokens,r.observed_total_tokens FROM agent_work w LEFT JOIN agent_work_scheduling s USING(work_id) JOIN ranked r USING(work_id) WHERE (w.trigger_kind='reminder' OR w.source_ref_kind='reminder_fire' OR w.root_trigger_kind='reminder') AND r.rn=1 AND r.observed_total_tokens IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.sequence
reproduction.identity_projection: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 outcome_id and turn_id; no raw identity retained

prior_price_estimate.meaning: Prior short-context Sol price substitution on aggregate counters; not dated actual-model billing or additional subscription consumption

qualification: Current work classification fields can change; this query independently reproduces the exact original aggregate and all selected outcomes.
